description: Handmade: A Children's Market is a holiday market where children from Bloom Co-op and other children in the community host their own handmade market, and visitors can shop for gifts from these young creatives. It takes place on December 5, 2026, Time TBD, at 18125 Jaybird Lane in Lebanon, Missouri. More details are still to come.
